question: True or false: a team with a 70% chance of winning each of its last four matches will probably win all four?
answer: False. Each win has to happen, so the chances multiply: 0.7 × 0.7 × 0.7 × 0.7 is about 0.24. A team that is favourite in every single match still has only about one chance in four of winning the lot.
move: Being favourite at every step is not being favourite for the journey.
trap: Favourite in every match feels like favourite for the whole run.
reference: Feller, An Introduction to Probability Theory and Its Applications, Volume 1, Wiley, 1968
